issue.title: Perf-check recipes recreate legacy in-tree sdd/ tree with gitignored JSON
issue.description:
Perf-check recipes and CI artifact uploads still write runtime JSON under legacy in-tree sdd/plans/<YYYYMM>/perf_artifacts/ paths (e.g. sdd/plans/202604/perf_artifacts/rust_backend_phase7_floor_check.json and siblings listed in .gitignore). These files are gitignored but keep recreating a local sdd/ tree after the tracked root sdd/ directory was removed (plan 202610/remove_stray_root_sdd_dir.md deliberately left gitignored leftovers in place).

Desired: relocate runtime perf JSON out of the legacy in-tree sdd/ paths (managed tmp, artifacts dir, or sidecar store) so a clean checkout never regrows sdd/ locally.

task_type_fields.impact: A removed root sdd/ directory keeps being recreated locally, confusing checkout-leak guards and developers.
task_type_fields.repro: Run perf-check recipes on a clean checkout; sdd/plans/<YYYYMM>/perf_artifacts/*.json reappears locally.

issue.creation_reason: Follow-up from the approved stray-root-sdd removal plan; runtime JSON keeps regrowing a local sdd/ tree.
